name: Trigger Inspection Demo
description: Station inspection on demand: waits at a reduced camera rate, captures one frame per HTTP or GPIO trigger, and returns an OK/NG verdict over HTTP and MQTT. The sample check measures brightness and contrast in a region of interest.
description_zh: 按需工位质检：待机时降低相机采样率，收到 HTTP 或 GPIO 触发后抓拍一帧，通过 HTTP 响应和 MQTT 返回 OK/NG 判定。示例判定规则为感兴趣区域的亮度与对比度。
author: Seeed Studio
